key_idea: Each envelope serves a subset of card types with cost (max w * max h) * sum q - area used, so it is a partition of 15 items into at most k groups: submask-enumeration DP.
sketch: Precompute cost[mask] for all 2^n subsets. dp_j[mask] = min over submasks s containing the lowest set bit of cost[s] + dp_{j-1}[mask ^ s], repeated k-1 times; forcing the lowest bit into the group cuts enumeration to 3^(n-1) per layer, about 72M steps total. Envelopes need not match an existing card, only the component-wise maximum. Values reach ~1.5e13, use int64. Stress-tested against set-partition brute force.
